import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from a CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the dataset to create a long format for Petal and Sepal measurements
df_melted = pd.melt(data, id_vars='species', value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])

# Plot a boxplot to compare Petal and Sepal measurements across species
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.boxplot(x='variable', y='value', hue='species', data=df_melted)
plt.title('Petal and Sepal Measurements Across Iris Species')
plt.xlabel('Measurement Type')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.legend(title='Species')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
